rows.grounds: From context: installation around a prasāda/sanctuary; genitive indicating location/association (of the shrine).
Locative plural indicating placement in the four directions around the shrine.
Fused token as given (sandhi fusion marked in form by elision); conveys placement in the fire direction and in the Īśa direction, followed by 'then' in sequence of installation steps.
Nominative plural subject/object in this procedural list: pavilions to be set up/placed.
